name: Input Buffer
description: Delays a click or wave release by a few ticks when the predicted path says you would die.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the input buffer on or off.

stage.name: Buffer stage
stage.description: Max delay in ticks (240 ticks = 1 second, so 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60fps). Format: all inputs / wave inputs.

horizon.name: Look-ahead (ticks)
horizon.description: How far ahead the path is checked for hazards.

logging.name: Debug log
logging.description: Log every time the buffer saves you (check Geode logs).
